title: Buducnost capture Erste Liga title
description: Derby - Buducnost 69-74 Buducnost are Erste Liga champions. They topped Derby on the road tonight to sweep the championship series. The guests trailed by 3 points after first quarter, but they rallied back to get the 20-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 74-69. Buducnost outrebounded Derby 41-29 including 31 on the defensive glass. Bosnian center Kenan Kamenjas (207-2000) orchestrated the victory with a double-double by scoring 19 points and 13 rebounds. Nigerian-American Rasheed Sulaimon (194-1994, college: Maryland) contributed with 17 points and 4 assists for the winners. Four Buducnost players scored in double figures. The former international point guard Igor Drobnjak (188-2000) replied with 19 points and 5 assists (was perfect 8-for-8 from the free throw line) and the former international Emir Hadzibegovic (204-1996) added 17 points and 5 rebounds in the effort…
